items.title: Localizing the category of compactifications at the right multiplicative system recovers the category of compactifyable schemes
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness), section 'The local structure of a finite type module'
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the forgetful functor (X, Xbar) -> X induces an equivalence between the localization of the category of compactifications at the right multiplicative system introduced in the preceding lemma and the category of compactifyable schemes over a quasi-compact quasi-separated base S (statement lines 9475-9484). The content is the third step of an equivalence check: essential surjectivity is immediate, full faithfulness on morphisms requires constructing, for an arbitrary morphism X -> Y of compactifyable schemes, a compactification of Y followed by a relative compactification of X over it, so that the localized morphism is represented (proof lines 9496-9503); and well definedness requires showing that two such representations producing the same morphism X -> Y are equal in the localized category, which uses the right-localization calculus to assume a common refinement and then takes the equalizer of the two proper maps Xbar' -> Xbar'' inside Xbar', a closed subscheme by separatedness of Xbar'' over S, to precompose with a map in the multiplicative system (proof lines 9504-9524). The equalizer trick is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
